DEFINITION: ISIA Ski Instructor & TD2 Mountain Leader

HOME.HELLO: The mountain is not just a place: it's my way of life
HOME.HELLO_SUBTITLE: Mountain professional with dual official qualifications (Alpine Skiing & Trekking). I offer my experience to ski schools and outdoor organizations with a clear goal: to share a passion for nature, ensure maximum safety, and create unforgettable experiences for kids and adults alike.
HOME.PLACE_SUBTITLE: The countries highlighted on the map represent the places where I had the opportunity to work and grow. Each of them contributed to developing new skills, greater adaptability, and a more international vision of my professional journey.
HOME.MY_STORY_SUBTITLE: My story begins in Bariloche, in the heart of Argentine Patagonia, a place where mountains, nature, and sports are part of daily life. Growing up among Patagonian lakes and peaks shaped my path early on, turning a childhood passion into my profession. Over the years, I've brought my experience across the globe — from Switzerland to Japan, through Andorra, France, and Italy. Today, I am a Ski Instructor (ISIA Stamp) and Mountain Leader (TD2). My goal? To help people experience the mountains safely, whether taking their first steps on skis, exploring alpine trails, or simply learning to respect and listen to nature.

CONTACTS.TITLE: Ready for the next adventure?
CONTACTS.SUBTITLE: Whether you are looking for an instructor for the winter season or a guide for your summer hikes, let's talk about your project!
